```artifact
Feature: Battery Management System

  Scenario Outline: GUI can compute battery ETA from a history of remaining battery amounts
    Given the GUI is connected to a battery amount sensor
    When the GUI receives a history of remaining battery amounts: <battery_history>
    Then the GUI should compute the battery ETA as <battery_eta>

    Examples:
      | battery_history | battery_eta |
      | [100, 90, 80]   | 30          |
      | [100, 50, 20]   | 60          |
      | [100, 10, 0]    | 120         |

  Scenario Outline: GUI can compute a "low battery" alarm when battery ETA is <30min
    Given the GUI is connected to a battery amount sensor
    When the GUI receives a history of remaining battery amounts: <battery_history>
    Then the GUI should compute the battery ETA as <battery_eta>
    And the GUI should display a "low battery" alarm if <battery_eta> < 30

    Examples:
      | battery_history | battery_eta | battery_alarm |
      | [100, 90, 80]   | 30          | no            |
      | [100, 50, 20]   | 60          | no            |
      | [100, 10, 0]    | 120         | no            |
      | [100, 50, 10]   | 20          | yes           |

  Scenario Outline: GUI can compute a "critically low battery" alarm when battery ETA is <10min
    Given the GUI is connected to a battery amount sensor
    When the GUI receives a history of remaining battery amounts: <battery_history>
    Then the GUI should compute the battery ETA as <battery_eta>
    And the GUI should display a "critically low battery" alarm if <battery_eta> < 10

    Examples:
      | battery_history | battery_eta | battery_alarm |
      | [100, 90, 80]   | 30          | no            |
      | [100, 50, 20]   | 60          | no            |
      | [100, 10, 0]    | 120         | no            |
      | [100, 50, 10]   | 20          | no            |
      | [100, 50, 5]    | 10          | yes           |

  Scenario Outline: GUI needs to be able to read hardware battery presence and chargeability sensors
    Given the GUI is connected to a battery amount sensor
    When the GUI reads the battery presence and chargeability sensors
    Then the GUI should display the battery status as <battery_status>

    Examples:
      | battery_presence | battery_chargeability | battery_status |
      | true             | true                  | charging       |
      | true             | false                 | discharging    |
      | false            | true                  | absent         |
      | false            | false                 | unavailable    |

  Scenario Outline: GUI needs to have a "battery failure" alarm that is activated when the battery is absent, unavailable, or unchargeable
    Given the GUI is connected to a battery amount sensor
    When the GUI reads the battery presence and chargeability sensors
    Then the GUI should display a "battery failure" alarm if <battery_status> is "absent" or "unavailable" or "discharging"

    Examples:
      | battery_presence | battery_chargeability | battery_status | battery_alarm |
      | true             | true                  | charging       | no            |
      | true             | false                 | discharging    | yes           |
      | false            | true                  | absent         | yes           |
      | false            | false                 | unavailable    | yes           |
```
